title: MDLxDCC.org Website Archive Context — Light
purpose: How to use www.MDLxDCC.org and /context as machine-readable project archive for LLMs.

blocks.title: Website as archive
blocks.text: www.MDLxDCC.org is a public archive of BD work. It contains many papers/pages, though not all Python code. It can serve humans and future LLM ingestion.

blocks.title: Context folder proposal
blocks.text: Create /context/ with compact machine-readable .json/.md/.txt packs. These are not normal browsing pages; they are compressed context sources for MentalArena and LLMs.

blocks.title: URL vs token caveat
blocks.text: Giving a URL is not automatically token-free. The Lab should fetch/cache/condense context itself when possible, and only use provider-native web/URL tools intentionally.

blocks.title: Best practice
blocks.text: ZIP is archive/export. JSON/MD context pack is model-readable compressed knowledge. Local cache avoids re-fetching. Provider file/search/cache is optional optimization. Do not rely blindly on every API model browsing URLs correctly.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
